Messages.Author: Pacal
Messages.Body:
Vamp A takes an action that is blocked by Vamp B controlled by his prey.

Vamp B sends Vamp A to torpor in the resulting combat.

Can Vamp A use freakdrive to untap even though he is in torpor?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes, if he has superior Fortitude.
